note: Phase 2 authoritative execution manifest. Support-only unit decoder regressions, HTTP conformance, browser-request probes, smoke tests, and extra regressions stay outside this map.

unit.claim: Incident create decode rejects undeclared members, rejects `initial_memberships`, and normalizes `incident_key` with trim plus NFC before uniqueness.
unit.out_of_scope: Durable create persistence remains integration evidence.

unit.claim: Store.CreateIncident commits the bootstrap `admin` membership plus both incident-wide and per-user workbook-preference rows.
unit.out_of_scope: HTTP envelope and header emission remain support coverage.

unit.claim: The committed create result returns the stable `/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}` location value.
unit.out_of_scope: Actual `Location` header emission remains support coverage.

unit.claim: Incident create idempotency scopes by actor plus normalized request, exact replay returns the original committed result, divergent replay rejects, and replay keeps the incident row, bootstrap membership, workbook-preference rows, owner mutation artifacts, and route idempotency stable.
unit.out_of_scope: HTTP replay envelope proof remains support coverage.

unit.claim: Incident patch decode allows only promoted fields, requires `base_incident_version`, and keeps structural no-ops version-stable.
unit.out_of_scope: Persisted patch consequences remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Membership create requires exactly one selector, resolves targets by lookup-only `user_id` or `email`, returns canonical `user_not_found` or `user_inactive`, and rejects invitation-only fields without any auto-create path.
unit.out_of_scope: Live HTTP envelope proof remains support coverage.

unit.claim: Store-backed membership patch and delete reject stale `base_membership_version` values without mutating durable membership state.
unit.out_of_scope: Pure decoder shape and `last_incident_admin` guard coverage stay on the executed support-only unit surface.

unit.claim: The incident access decision helper returns `incident_not_found` for no membership and `authorization_denied` for insufficient incident role.
unit.out_of_scope: Deployment-admin-without-membership route breadth remains paired support or integration inventory coverage.

unit.claim: Extension discovery keeps the singleton route shape, exact profile fields, canonical ordering, and no pagination members.
unit.out_of_scope: Runtime auth and leak checks remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Reserved-family dispatch preserves base-route precedence, claimed-family routing, reserved-but-unclaimed canonical 404s, and ordinary outside-family 404s.
unit.out_of_scope: Real authenticated dispatch remains integration evidence.

unit.title: Phase 2 U-2-11 ordinary landing shell creates an incident, refreshes session-visible membership, routes to the workbook by incident_id, and falls back when a stale incident selection is no longer visible
unit.claim: The ordinary landing shell creates an incident, refreshes session-visible membership on workbook entry, stores the selected `incident_id` in the route, and returns cleanly to landing when a stale selection is no longer visible.

unit.title: Phase 2 U-2-12 ordinary incident shell gates promoted-field controls by incident role, hides membership-admin controls from non-admin members, and returns to landing when incident access is lost
unit.claim: The ordinary incident shell exposes promoted-field controls only for reviewer or admin roles, hides membership-administration controls from non-admin members, and triggers the landing fallback when incident access disappears.

unit.title: Phase 2 U-2-13 ordinary incident shell issues membership create, patch, and delete requests with versioned payloads and refreshes session role after each mutation
unit.claim: The ordinary incident shell emits the expected membership mutation payloads, includes versioned patch or delete bodies, and refreshes the session-visible incident role after each mutation.

integration.claim: Incident create persists the incident row, bootstrap membership, workbook preferences, and owner-level mutation artifacts on the current Phase 2 audit substrate atomically, while hook-forced rollback leaves no surviving Phase 2 mutation artifacts.
integration.out_of_scope: `change_sets` migration remains an owner/docs follow-on, not Phase 2 evidence.

integration.claim: Real create with trimmed decomposed input normalizes the response key, replay with the composed form returns the original committed resource, divergent replay rejects, opposite-form duplicates on distinct requests fail with `incident_key_conflict`, and the incident row, bootstrap membership, workbook-preference rows, owner mutation artifacts, and route idempotency remain stable.
integration.out_of_scope: None for the declared replay and normalization contract.

integration.claim: One same-session role progression `no membership -> viewer -> reviewer -> admin -> removed` re-derives access immediately for every `ControlBoundaryInventory()` route, including workbook-preference reads, membership-admin routes, and the Timeline websocket boundary.
integration.out_of_scope: Deployment-admin-without-membership breadth is paired with the support inventory sweep.

integration.claim: Real incident patch persists only promoted fields, rejects stale versions, and advances `incident_version` only on material change.
integration.out_of_scope: None for the declared patch contract.

integration.claim: Extension discovery succeeds for an authenticated zero-membership session and leaks no provider secrets or live claim payloads.
integration.out_of_scope: None for the declared discovery contract.

integration.claim: Reserved but unclaimed family roots and descendants return canonical `extension_profile_not_claimed`, while outside-family paths preserve ordinary 404 handling.
integration.out_of_scope: None for the declared dispatch contract.

e2e.claim: Real browser incident create bootstraps the creator as incident admin and lands on the ordinary workbook shell.
e2e.out_of_scope: None for the declared browser create-flow contract.

e2e.claim: The ordinary shell exposes incident discovery, raw `/?incident_id=...` deep-link retrieval, and promoted-field-only patching on the real browser surface.
e2e.out_of_scope: None for the declared browser patch-flow contract.

e2e.title: E-2-03 lets incident admins manage memberships and hides those controls from non-admin members on the ordinary shell
e2e.claim: Incident admins manage memberships on the ordinary shell and non-admin incident members do not receive those controls.
